summary.text: Virgle Osborne is a Republican state representative from District 2 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
He appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with both Republican and Democratic nominations.

paragraphs.text: Virgle Osborne was born in Roseburg, Oregon, and attended Umpqua Community College.
His career experience includes owning an off-road accessory shop and working as a sales manager for FCC Commercial Furniture.
Osborne also chaired the Douglas County Planning Commission and served as a team lead for the Douglas County Sheriff's Department Search and Rescue.
Osborne was assigned to the Business and Labor, House Energy and Environment, and Economic Recovery and Prosperity committees in the 2023-2024 session.
